rubric_items.reason: Uses only existing modules and symbols: patientsRouter, PatientService, PatientRepo, PatientsPage, dateTime, client.ts, existing index. It follows the route/service/repo layering. No new endpoint, table, migration or job.
S-1 to S-5 are each mapped to components, and every AC (earliest Scheduled, TZ, doctor name, closed excluded, None as plain text, link, paging/search/sort, no medical history) has a mechanism.
Method, path, list shape and the new field next_appointment: null | { id, starts_at, doctor_name } are precise. The starts_at wire format and the doctor-name source column are not stated.
Most choices are cited or asked. But the claim that dateTime renders in the hospital time zone rests on no cited fact, and REQ-2..REQ-6 are marked known in requirements but listed as assumed.
Trade-offs cover extending the route vs a new route, a per-row lookup vs a grouped query, reusing dateTime vs a new format, and excluding medical columns.
Clear and well structured. The known/assumed lists contradict the per-requirement status fields, which hurts consistency.
